access_notes: Outbound HTTP fetches to edmunds.com, jlwranglerforums.com, and s3.amazonaws.com returned HTTP 403 Forbidden via the sandbox network proxy. Per Section 3 of the task specification, the established indexed-snippet fallback via search_web was used to extract exact cover indices, page numbers, model codes, Quick Order Packages (CPOS), FWP/MSRP prices, and powertrain tables from the authentic MY2024 2-Door and 4-Door Customer Preferred Code Guides and Edmunds MY2024 Wrangler / Wrangler 4xe trim specifications.

sources.title: Edmunds MY2024 Jeep Wrangler & Wrangler 4xe US Features & Specs (Reconciled Transcription)
sources.coverage_notes: Covers 29 of 31 canonical active MY2024 US consumer candidates (39 of 41 positive factory QOP/transmission cells). Two factory-confirmed MY2024 configurations are absent from Edmunds: JL24-18 (Unlimited Sahara 3.6L V6 8-spd auto, JLJP74 QOP 24G, recorded as ECE-002) and JL24-27 (Unlimited Jeep Beach 4xe, JLXL74 QOP 29E, recorded as ECE-003). Also surfaces two provisional ambiguities quarantined by factory order guides: JL24-Q01 (Sahara manual) and JL24-Q02 (High Altitude non-hybrid gas).
